description:
Schedule a campaign

Schedule up to 50 existing posts, videos, and stories, including unchanged published posts/stories sent to new destinations in one transaction. Every item must pass ownership, destination, media, and lifecycle checks; if one fails nothing is scheduled. Confirm all destinations and times first.

requestKey.description: Stable key for a cross-post delivery. Reuse after a lost response; use a new key after cancellation.

name: bulkSchedule
